conclusion.scope: This exploratory Memos pilot and these two concrete workflows, not all context methods or organizations
conclusion.primaryInterpretation: A has more registered completions. On the four uncontested task clusters, A completed 8/8 attempts and B 5/8. These are descriptive observed outcomes, not proof of population-wide superiority.
conclusion.resources: B used less time and fewer total reported tokens per attempt, but uncached coding input was almost identical. On the uncontested subset, A used fewer coding tokens and less coding time per verified completion, counting failed attempts.
conclusion.maintenance: Both maintained the controlled changed facts consistently. B edited an additional context artifact and consumed more maintenance tokens; editing and review timings are separately recorded. Reviewer scope/input omissions and coordinator interventions limit whole-workflow cost interpretation.
conclusion.unknown: Completed human review effort, coordinator effort, actual billing, failure-repair effort and company savings are unavailable.
